notes: Shared defaults. Per-machine state goes to laya.local.json (gitignored): enabled null = never asked, true = use when reachable, false = never use and never ask. Re-enable with `laya-check.mjs --laya`. provider: laya (default) | jev — who reranks an ambiguous short list in find.mjs; env DECISION_PROVIDER or --provider wins. jev needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment (never stored here).
